title: Microprobe visual lexicon and trace protocol
content:
Purpose:
This is a working notebook to capture a compact visual lexicon for microprobe dashboards and an accompanying trace/span protocol for low-latency inference investigations. Goal: reduce cognitive load for oncall and shorten MTTI by standardizing widget names, color semantics, and trace anchors across probes.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Widget naming should be short, prefixed by lane (probe/kvcache/route/model). Example: probe.kv_warmth, lane.kv_hitrate, model.variant_tail_latency.
- Colors: green = within SLO, amber = approaching budget (>=80%), red = SLO breach. Use single-color thresholds across team dashboards.
- Traces: anchor traces to span attribute probe.id and session.token_flow_id; store compact prompt hash for cross-correlation (prompt_sha1).

Glossary / lexicon (unique terms we will standardize):
- kv_warmth_index: heuristic 0..1 score measuring proportion of requests served from prefix/KV cache within 30s of last warmup.
- kv_cache_hit_rate_v2: (cache_hits / cache_lookups) over rolling 1m, tagged by tenant_id and model.variant.
- prefix_replay_ratio: percent of requests that triggered a prefix recompute vs. reused prefix (useful for streaming).
- multi_hop_latency_path: descriptive label for latency decomposition across: route_decision -> model_infer -> kv_lookup -> postproc.
- token_split_rate: fraction of tokens that entail an extra tokenization boundary (useful for non-uniform tokenizers).
- probe.microburst_index: unitless metric that counts short bursts of >X rps within Y seconds, used to detect burst-driven tail latency.

Span / trace naming and attributes (protocol):
- Root span name: request/<route_name> e.g. request/generate-text.
- Important child spans:
  - span: route.decision  | attrs: {route.policy, fallback_reason, route_latency_ms}
  - span: kv.lookup        | attrs: {kv_cache_state: warm|cold|miss, kv_cache_hit: true|false, kv_warmth_index}
  - span: model.infer      | attrs: {model.name, model.variant, seq_length, kv_reused: true|false, tokens_generated}
  - span: postprocess     | attrs: {policy.filtering_applied, output_tokens}
- Cross-correlation keys (always attach): {prompt_sha1, session_id, request_id, tenant_id}. Keep prompt_sha1 to 8 hex chars in spans to limit trace size but allow join.
- Sampling guidance: sample 1% of all requests but 100% of requests with probe.microburst_index >= 1 and 100% of requests with latency > P95_SLO * 1.2.

Dashboard widget conventions (naming / arrangement):
- Lane prefixing: lane.<domain>.<metric>  e.g. lane.kv.kv_cache_hit_rate_v2, lane.model.p95_latency_ms
- Microprobe groupings (compact 3x2 panels) for quick triage:
  - Heatmap: microprobe.heatmap.tokenflow (x-axis: minute, y-axis: tenant percentile)
  - Top offenders: probe.top_tenants_by_tail_cost (table with tenant, tail_latency, qps)
  - KV view: lane.kv.kv_cache_hit_rate_v2 (sparkline) + lane.kv.kv_warmth_index (gauge)
  - Route view: lane.route.latency_quantiles + lane.route.fallback_rate
- Link buttons: every widget should include a short link to a trace search prefilled with attributes (e.g., probe.id + prompt_sha1). URL format template to use in panels documented in the confluence link.

Investigation playbook (compact runbook for operators):
1) Surface: alert or dashboard shows probe.microburst_index spike or lane.model.p95_latency_ms rising.
2) Triaging order (cheap -> expensive):
   - Check lane.kv.kv_cache_hit_rate_v2 and kv_warmth_index. If hit rate drops concurrently with tail latency, suspect cache churn or eviction policy change.
   - Check route.fallback_rate and route.decision latencies (if routes changed, fallback to slower variant may explain tail).
   - Drill into model.variant_tail_latency and model.infer span attr seq_length distribution. Large sequences can amplify tail.
3) Trace anchoring: use the smallest probe-qualified span (kv.lookup or route.decision) and follow model.infer spans. Use prompt_sha1 to group similar prompts.
4) Mitigations: quick actions list
   - Increase KV cache retention for the offending tenant (temp config override).
   - Route traffic to dedicated pool / lower-cost variant if autoscaler overwhelmed.
   - Rollback recent quantization changes that affect kernel selection (if flagged by release tag in model.infer attrs).

Mini-experiment matrix (to try next sprint):
- Experiment A: bump kv retention from 60s -> 180s for a small cohort, measure kv_cache_hit_rate_v2 and cost-per-token. Metric target: +10ppt hit rate, cost delta <5%.
- Experiment B: dynamic probe sampling: raise sampling to 10% when probe.microburst_index >=1 and measure MTTI improvement for incidents.
- Experiment C: colorblind-friendly palette test for operator dashboards (quick A/B to ensure thresholds still perceptible).

Instrumentation checklist (items to ship to telemetry repo):
- [ ] Add prompt_sha1 (8 hex) to root and model.infer spans.
- [ ] Emit kv_warmth_index as a gauge in the request lifecycle stream (tagged by tenant_id).
- [ ] Route change events: emit route.policy_revision and route.policy_owner in trace attrs.
- [ ] Dashboard link templates: centralize url builder in telemetry/frontend repo (PR referenced above).

Open questions & unresolved decisions (notes to discuss in next obs sync):
- Sampling math: current 1% baseline may miss rare multi-tenant interactions. Tradeoffs: 1% -> 5% increases storage by ~4x. Need SRE cost approval (ask infra-finance).
- Prompt hashing collisions: 8 hex is compact but collision risk. Do we store full sha256 in offline store and 8 hex in traces? (pref: yes).
- Unified color thresholds: should engineering and support dashboards share identical thresholds or allow small offsets? (ops wants strict alignment).

Short raw notes from pairing session (3/19):
- Marco: saw an incident where kv_warmth_index oscillated after a release that touched eviction policy; rapid rebalance across nodes caused bursts.
- Aisha: suggested a probe that measures prefix_replay_ratio from the client-side sampling to detect early prefix churn.
- Claire: will prototype dashboard panel that overlays kv_warmth_index and probe.microburst_index with sampling dots linking to traces.

To-do (next 2 weeks):
- Claire: prototype microprobe panel + link button (due 2025-03-27)
- Marco + Jordan: validate sampling cost math with telemetry infra (due 2025-03-28)
- Aisha: draft policy for kv retention toggles (due 2025-03-31)

References & quick links:
- Linear ticket for probe sprint: https://linear.app/INF/PROBE-214-mini-probe-sprint
- Telemetry PR (url): https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/482
- Draft confluence guide (internal): confluence://obs/visual-lexicon-v0

Appendix - sample query snippets (informal):
- kv hit rate by tenant (pseudo-sql):
  SELECT tenant_id, avg(kv_cache_hit) as hit_rate
  FROM request_metrics
  WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
  ORDER BY hit_rate asc

- trace search template (for link button):
  /traces?service=inference&attrs=prompt_sha1:{prompt_sha1},probe.id:{probe_id},model.variant:{model.variant}&from=-15m

Endnotes: keep this doc thin and experiment-driven. Purpose is not to replace longer playbooks but to provide a compact, operator-facing lexicon and experiment runway for microprobes. Update after initial prototype tests.

-- Claire H. (obs lead)
